# Expedito Olimi

> Microbial ecologist and nematologist studying how plants assemble and inherit their associated microorganisms. Erwin Schrödinger Fellow and Principal Investigator, Institute of Environmental Biotechnology, TU Graz, Austria.

Every page on this site is also available as plain Markdown at the same path with a `.md` extension.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kaboyo.github.io/index.md): short biography and profile links (Google Scholar, ORCID, GitHub)
- [Research](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/research.md): research themes, current MoToMi project, resources and methods
- [Publications](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/publications.md): complete publication list with DOIs, manuscripts under review and theses
- [CV](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/cv.md): positions, education, funding and awards, teaching, presentations and service

## Publication summaries

One page per peer-reviewed paper: citation, plain-language summary, key findings, methods, keywords and links.

- [Qi et al. 2026, Microbiome](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-qi-2026-seed-microbiome-review.md): What do we know about the seed microbiome?
- [Wei et al. 2026, Communications Biology](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-wei-2026-microplastic-lead-viruses.md): Microplastic and lead shift microbiomes enriching viral auxiliary metabolic genes for potential polylactic acid degradation
- [Chen et al. 2026, mSystems](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-chen-2026-tomato-seed-microbiome.md): The tomato seed microbiome is mainly shaped by host genotype and production site
- [Abulebda et al. 2026, Applied Soil Ecology](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-abulebda-2026-wireworm-behaviour.md): Behavioural responses of Agriotes lineatus and A. litigiosus wireworms to natural substances, synthetic volatile organic compounds and entomopathogenic fungi: implications for sustainable pest management
- [Ajibade et al. 2025, Journal of Sustainable Agriculture and Environment](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-ajibade-2025-nigerian-vegetable-seeds.md): Indigenous Nigerian vegetables harbour plant species-specific seed microbial signatures for bacteria and fungi
- [Olimi et al. 2025, Environmental Microbiology Reports](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-olimi-2025-mondia-whitei.md): Insights into the Mondia whitei microbiome across geographic regions in Eastern Africa
- [Olimi et al. 2025, Environmental Microbiome](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-olimi-2025-bioinoculants-volatiles.md): Plant microbiome responses to bioinoculants and volatiles
- [Vitali et al. 2025, Scientific Reports](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-vitali-2025-paenibacillus-k16.md): Combined genomic and phenomic analyses reveal multifunctionality of Paenibacillus polymyxa K16 for plant nutrition, growth, and health
- [Furmanczyk et al. 2025, Soil Systems](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-furmanczyk-2025-soil-nematodes.md): An analysis of soil nematode communities across diverse horticultural cropping systems
- [Bigiotti et al. 2025, Applied Soil Ecology](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-bigiotti-2025-microarthropods.md): Estimating microarthropod diversity in cropping systems by comparing ecological indices across Europe
- [Vitali et al. 2025, Acta Horticulturae](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-vitali-2025-phenomics-genomics.md): Combining phenomics and genomics for bioproduct development and use in agriculture
- [Oaikhena et al. 2024, Scientific Reports](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-oaikhena-2024-medicinal-plant-phyllosphere.md): The phyllosphere of Nigerian medicinal plants Euphorbia lateriflora and Ficus thonningii is inhabited by a specific microbiota
- [Olimi et al. 2023, Applied Soil Ecology](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-olimi-2023-apple-orchard-nematodes.md): Bioinoculants and organic soil amendments affect nematode diversity in apple orchards
- [Olimi et al. 2022, Frontiers in Soil Science](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-olimi-2022-biodynamic-preparations.md): Deciphering the microbial composition of biodynamic preparations and their effects on the apple rhizosphere microbiome
- [Rybakova et al. 2022, Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-rybakova-2022-serratia-volatiles.md): To defend or to attack? Antagonistic interactions between Serratia plymuthica and fungal plant pathogens, a species-specific volatile dialogue
- [Olimi et al. 2022, Environmental Microbiome](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-olimi-2022-strawberry-microbiome.md): Insights into the microbiome assembly during different growth stages and storage of strawberry plants
- [Kusstatscher et al. 2021, Frontiers in Plant Science](https://kaboyo.github.io/p/pub-kusstatscher-2021-pumpkin-breeding.md): Microbiome-assisted breeding to understand cultivar-dependent assembly in Cucurbita pepo
